title: Blaze Grills — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Blaze Grills.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Born to Grill." Specialty tier. Blaze Grills offers commercial-grade 304 stainless steel construction at mid-range prices. Their LED-illuminated controls, flame-stabilizing grids, and lifetime warranty make them the best value in the built-in outdoor segment. Growing fast among outdoor kitchen builders.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Outdoor kitchen builders wanting value. Customers stepping up from freestanding to built-in.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Blaze Grills:

• 304 stainless at mid-range pricing — best value in built-in grills

• Lifetime warranty on burners and cooking grids

• LED illuminated controls for nighttime grilling

• Full outdoor kitchen ecosystem at every price point

• Fastest-growing built-in grill brand
